records.literal_gloss: How blessed [are the] blameless of way, the [ones] walking in [the] instruction of YHWH!

en.L: How blessed [are] the blameless in [their] way, who walk in the instruction of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}!
en.B: How blessed are those whose way of life is without fault, who walk by the instruction of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}!
en.R: Life is truly good for people who live without blame and follow the teaching of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}.

fr.L: Heureux les intègres dans [leur] voie, qui marchent dans la loi {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} !
fr.B: Qu’ils sont heureux, ceux dont la conduite est sans reproche, qui vivent selon l’instruction {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} !
fr.R: Ceux qui mènent une vie sans reproche et qui suivent l’enseignement {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} sont vraiment heureux.

sw.L: Heri walio wakamilifu katika njia [yao], wanaotembea katika mafundisho ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}!
sw.B: Heri wale ambao mwenendo wao hauna kasoro, wanaoenenda kwa mafundisho ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}!
sw.R: Watu wanaoishi bila lawama na kufuata mafundisho ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} wana furaha kweli.

es.L: ¡Dichosos los íntegros en [su] camino, los que andan en la instrucción {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}!
es.B: ¡Dichosos los que llevan una vida sin falta, los que andan según la instrucción {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}!
es.R: Qué buena es la vida de quienes viven sin culpa y siguen la enseñanza {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}.

vi.L: Phước thay những người trọn vẹn trong đường lối [mình], là những người bước đi trong sự dạy dỗ của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}!
vi.B: Phước hạnh thay những người có nếp sống không chỗ chê trách, là những người bước đi theo lời dạy dỗ của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}!
vi.R: Thật hạnh phúc cho những người sống không có gì đáng trách và làm theo lời dạy của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}.

ko.L: 얼마나 복된가, [그] 길에서 흠 없는 자들, {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 가르침 안에서 걷는 자들은!
ko.B: 흠 없이 살아가며 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 가르침을 따라 걷는 사람들은 얼마나 복된가!
ko.R: 나무랄 데 없이 살면서 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 가르침을 따르는 사람들은 참으로 행복하다.

decisions.choice: Psalm 119: an alphabet poem in twenty-two stanzas
decisions.reason: The psalm is an acrostic, the longest in the Bible. It has twenty-two stanzas, one for each letter of the Hebrew alphabet, and each of the eight verses of a stanza begins with that letter. The first stanza (verses 1-8) begins with aleph. Nearly every verse names God's law with one of eight words (instruction, testimonies, precepts, statutes, commands, judgments, word, saying), and each is given the same wording throughout. The psalm has no title.

decisions.choice: How blessed: an exclamation about a life that goes well
decisions.reason: The word ('ashre) is an exclamation: "oh, the blessings of ...". It speaks of the well-being of a life in step with God, as in 1:1. Psalm 119 opens like Psalm 1.
The word (tamim) means whole or sound, a life with nothing crooked in it. It does not claim that these people never sin (verse 176).
To walk in God's instruction is to live by it, a picture used all through the psalm.

The word (torah) means instruction or teaching, from a verb for pointing out the way. It is the first of eight words for God's law that run through this psalm, and covers all that God has taught his people, not only the rules of the law of Moses.
As in 1:1, Literal and Balanced keep the exclamation.
As in 1:1, Readable says what the word means.
As in the earlier psalms, Literal and Balanced say "instruction" and Readable "teaching"; "law" can sound like a legal code only. The psalm uses the same word for torah throughout.

decisions.choice: torah: "la loi" (Literal), "l'instruction" (Balanced), "l'enseignement" (Readable), the same word at each level throughout the psalm
alternatives: "la Loi" with a capital at every level
decisions.reason: Psalm 119 names God's word with eight terms, and each keeps one French wording per level so the reader can follow them. For torah Literal keeps the traditional "la loi", lowercase, since the word covers all God's teaching and not only the Law of Moses (meaning decision m5). Balanced says "l'instruction" and Readable "l'enseignement", as the Psalms drafts do.

decisions.choice: "le SEIGNEUR" in capitals for the divine name, with "Yahvé" as the reader's alternative, for the whole psalm
decisions.reason: As in the Pentateuch and Proverbs: capitals mark the name, as the English "the LORD" does. "L'Éternel", the Segond tradition, is the form a reviewer may prefer.

decisions.choice: "Heri" for 'ashre at Literal and Balanced; Readable "wana furaha kweli"
decisions.reason: As in Proverbs, "Heri" is the Swahili word that says how well off a person is. Readable says it plainly: such people "are truly happy".

decisions.choice: "mafundisho" for torah at every level; the psalm's eight words each keep one Swahili word
decisions.reason: Torah means teaching or instruction (m5); "sheria" (law) would sound like a legal code only, as the English decision says, and "mafundisho" is the word for torah in Proverbs. Psalm 119 names God's word with eight Hebrew words, and Swahili gives each one fixed word at every level, so that a reader can follow them through the psalm: "mafundisho" (torah), "shuhuda" (testimonies), "maagizo" (precepts), "kanuni" (statutes), "amri" (commands), "hukumu" (judgments), "neno" (word) and "kauli" (saying). Each is noted where it first appears. Readable keeps the same words, even where the English Readable rephrases them ("what you have declared", "laws").

The Hebrew torah is the LORD's teaching for life, not a law code only. As in Psalm 1, Literal and Balanced say "instrucción" and Readable "enseñanza". Psalm 119 names God's word with eight Hebrew words, and each keeps one Spanish wording all through the psalm: torah "instrucción" (L, B), "enseñanza" (R); testimonies "testimonios" (L), "decretos" (B), "lo que has declarado" (R); precepts "preceptos" (L, B), "instrucciones" (R); statutes "estatutos" (L, B), "leyes" (R); commands "mandamientos"; judgments "juicios" (L), "dictámenes" (B), "decisiones" (R); word "palabra"; saying "dicho" (L), "promesa" or "palabra" (B), "promesa" or "lo que dijiste" (R).

decisions.choice: dichosos (L, B); Qué buena es la vida de (R)
decisions.reason: As in Psalm 1:1, ashre is "dichosos" at Literal and Balanced, the everyday word for a life that goes well, and Readable says that such people's life is good.

decisions.choice: torah is "sự dạy dỗ" (L), "lời dạy dỗ" (B), "lời dạy" (R) all through the psalm, as Psalm 1:2
decisions.reason: Psalm 119 has eight words for what God has said, and each keeps one Vietnamese wording throughout the psalm so that a reader can follow them. For torah, God's teaching as a whole (see the meaning decision), the wording is the one fixed in Psalm 1:2; "luật pháp", the familiar word, makes it sound like a legal code only.

decisions.choice: torah: "가르침" (teaching, instruction) at every level, as in Psalm 1:2, throughout the psalm; each of the psalm's eight words for God's word keeps one Korean word
decisions.reason: The Hebrew word (torah) is all that God has taught his people, not only a law code (meaning decision m5); "율법" is the familiar church word but says a law code in Korean. Psalm 119 names God's word with eight terms, and Korean keeps one wording for each so the reader can follow them: torah "가르침"; testimonies "증언"; precepts "법도"; statutes "규례"; commands "계명"; judgments "판결"; word (davar) "말씀"; saying ('imrah) "하신 말씀" or "약속". Each is recorded where it first appears.

decisions.choice: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}WH is {{divine_name:주|야훼}} at every level, with the particle outside the span ({{divine_name:주|야훼}}의, {{divine_name:주|야훼}}여), for the whole psalm
decisions.reason: As the style guide (section 7a) and Psalm 1:2. Verses 1-3 speak about God in the plain written style with the honorific (그분, -시-); the psalm turns to speak to God in verse 4. Korean has no deity_pronoun spans (no capitals); respect is carried by 그분, 주님, 께서 and -시-.

records.literal_gloss: How blessed [are those] keeping his testimonies; with all [the] heart they seek him.

en.L: How blessed [are] those who keep {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} testimonies; with all [the] heart they seek {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}.
en.B: How blessed are those who hold fast to {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} decrees and seek {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} with their whole heart.
en.R: Life is truly good for people who do what {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} has declared and who turn to {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} with all their heart.

fr.L: Heureux ceux qui gardent {{deity_pronoun:ses|Ses}} témoignages ; de tout cœur ils {{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} cherchent.
fr.B: Qu’ils sont heureux, ceux qui s’attachent à {{deity_pronoun:ses|Ses}} décrets et {{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} cherchent de tout leur cœur !
fr.R: Ceux qui font ce qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} a déclaré et qui se tournent vers {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} de tout leur cœur sont vraiment heureux.

sw.L: Heri wale wanaozishika shuhuda {{deity_pronoun:zake|Zake}}; kwa moyo wote wanamtafuta.
sw.B: Heri wale wanaoshikamana na shuhuda {{deity_pronoun:zake|Zake}} na kumtafuta kwa moyo wao wote.
sw.R: Watu wanaozitii shuhuda {{deity_pronoun:zake|Zake}} na kumgeukia kwa moyo wao wote wana furaha kweli.

es.L: ¡Dichosos los que guardan {{deity_pronoun:sus|Sus}} testimonios; con todo [el] corazón {{deity_pronoun:lo|Lo}} buscan!
es.B: ¡Dichosos los que se aferran a {{deity_pronoun:sus|Sus}} decretos y {{deity_pronoun:lo|Lo}} buscan de todo corazón!
es.R: Qué buena es la vida de quienes hacen lo que {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} ha declarado y se vuelven a {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} con todo el corazón.

vi.L: Phước thay những người gìn giữ các lời chứng của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}; với trọn lòng họ tìm kiếm {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.
vi.B: Phước hạnh thay những người giữ chặt các lời chứng của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} và hết lòng tìm kiếm {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.
vi.R: Thật hạnh phúc cho những người làm theo những điều {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã công bố và hết lòng quay về với {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.

ko.L: 얼마나 복된가, 그분의 증언들을 지키는 자들, 온 마음으로 그분을 찾는 자들은!
ko.B: 그분의 증언을 굳게 지키고 온 마음으로 그분을 찾는 사람들은 얼마나 복된가!
ko.R: 그분께서 알려 주신 뜻을 지키고 온 마음으로 그분께 돌아가는 사람들은 참으로 행복하다.

decisions.reason: As in 119:1.
The verb (natsar) is to guard or watch over something with care; here, to hold to what God has said and live by it.

decisions.choice: testimonies: what God has solemnly declared
decisions.reason: The word ('edot, also 'edut) is related to the word for a witness: what God has solemnly declared and stands witness to, the terms of his covenant (Deuteronomy 4:45). It is one of the psalm's eight words for God's law.

decisions.choice: seek him: turn to God, want him
decisions.reason: To seek God (darash) is to turn to him in prayer and worship and to want to know him, not to look for something lost.

decisions.choice: testimonies (L); decrees (B); what you have declared (R)
decisions.reason: Literal keeps "testimonies", close to the word's root. Balanced says "decrees" and Readable says plainly what they are. The psalm uses the same wording for this word throughout.
Readable says what seeking God means here.

decisions.choice: 'edot: "les témoignages" (Literal), "les décrets" (Balanced), "ce que tu as déclaré" (Readable), throughout the psalm
decisions.reason: Literal keeps "témoignages", close to the word's root (a witness). Balanced says "décrets", what God has solemnly laid down, and Readable says plainly what they are, as the English does. "Le Témoignage", capitalised, stays the name of the tablets in the ark.

"Shuhuda" is the plural of "ushuhuda", the word used for the testimony kept in the ark, so it keeps the link the Hebrew word has with God's solemn witness. The psalm uses it for this word throughout, at every level.

decisions.choice: deity_pronoun spans only on free pronouns
alternatives: a span on every reference to God
decisions.reason: Swahili marks most pronouns inside the verb ("wanamtafuta", "they seek him"), and a prefix cannot take a capital, so the deity_pronoun setting applies only to free pronouns and possessives ("shuhuda zake", "neno lako", "wewe"). Swahili therefore has fewer spans than the English in this psalm.

decisions.choice: testimonios (L); decretos (B); lo que has declarado (R)
decisions.reason: The Hebrew word (edot) comes from a root for bearing witness: what God has solemnly declared. Literal keeps "testimonios", close to the root; Balanced says "decretos" and Readable says plainly "lo que has declarado" (here "lo que él ha declarado"). The same wording is kept all through the psalm.

decisions.choice: 'edot is "lời chứng" (L, B) and "những điều Ngài đã công bố" (R) all through the psalm
decisions.reason: The word is related to the word for a witness: what God has solemnly declared (see the meaning decision). "lời chứng" keeps that root at Literal and Balanced, and is not used for any of the psalm's other seven words; Readable says plainly what they are, as the English Readable does. "chứng cớ", the older word, now means evidence in a case.

decisions.choice: 'edot: "증언" (testimonies) at Literal and Balanced; "알려 주신 뜻" (what he has declared) at Readable, throughout the psalm
decisions.reason: "증언" is God's solemn declaration of his will, the word's root sense; Korean readers know it from John, so Balanced can keep it where the English Balanced changes to "decrees", a word that would sound like a government order in Korean. Readable says plainly what they are. "증거", the older church word, now mostly means evidence.

records.literal_gloss: Also they do not do injustice; in his ways they walk.

en.L: Indeed, they do no wrong; in {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} ways they walk.
en.B: They do nothing crooked; they keep to the ways {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} has shown.
en.R: They do not do what is wrong. They live the way {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} wants them to.

fr.L: Oui, ils ne commettent pas d’injustice ; dans {{deity_pronoun:ses|Ses}} voies ils marchent.
fr.B: Ils ne font rien de tortueux ; ils suivent les chemins qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} a tracés.
fr.R: Ils ne font pas ce qui est mal. Ils vivent comme {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} le veut.

sw.L: Kweli, hawatendi uovu; katika njia {{deity_pronoun:zake|Zake}} wanatembea.
sw.B: Hawafanyi jambo lolote lililopotoka; wanashika njia alizowaonyesha.
sw.R: Hawafanyi yaliyo mabaya. Wanaishi kama anavyotaka waishi.

es.L: En verdad, no hacen injusticia; en {{deity_pronoun:sus|Sus}} caminos andan.
es.B: No hacen nada torcido; siguen los caminos que {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} ha mostrado.
es.R: No hacen lo que está mal. Viven como {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} quiere que vivan.

vi.L: Thật vậy, họ không làm điều bất chính; họ bước đi trong các đường lối của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.
vi.B: Họ không làm điều gì gian tà; họ đi theo những đường lối {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã chỉ ra.
vi.R: Họ không làm điều sai trái. Họ sống theo cách {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} muốn.

ko.L: 참으로 그들은 불의를 행하지 않고, 그분의 길들로 걷는다.
ko.B: 그들은 비뚤어진 일을 하지 않고, 그분께서 보여 주신 길을 따라간다.
ko.R: 그들은 나쁜 일을 하지 않는다. 그분께서 바라시는 대로 산다.

decisions.reason: The word ('awlah) is what is twisted or unjust, especially wrong done to others.

decisions.choice: walk in his ways: live as God directs
decisions.reason: God's ways are the paths of life he has shown his people (Deuteronomy 8:6).

decisions.choice: the ways he has shown (B); the way he wants (R)
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable say whose ways these are and what they are.

records.literal_gloss: You, you have commanded your precepts to keep [them] very much.

en.L: You have commanded {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} precepts, to keep [them] diligently.
en.B: You have laid down {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} precepts to be kept with all care.
en.R: You gave {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} instructions so that we would obey them with great care.

fr.L: Tu as commandé {{deity_pronoun:tes|Tes}} préceptes, pour [qu’ils soient] gardés avec grand soin.
fr.B: Tu as établi {{deity_pronoun:tes|Tes}} préceptes pour qu’on les observe avec le plus grand soin.
fr.R: Tu nous as donné {{deity_pronoun:tes|Tes}} consignes pour que nous les suivions avec beaucoup de soin.

sw.L: Wewe umeamuru maagizo {{deity_pronoun:yako|Yako}}, yashikwe kwa bidii.
sw.B: Umeweka maagizo {{deity_pronoun:yako|Yako}} ili yashikwe kwa uangalifu wote.
sw.R: Ulitupa maagizo {{deity_pronoun:yako|Yako}} ili tuyatii kwa uangalifu mkubwa.

es.L: Tú has mandado {{deity_pronoun:tus|Tus}} preceptos, para guardar[los] con diligencia.
es.B: Tú has establecido {{deity_pronoun:tus|Tus}} preceptos para que se cumplan con todo cuidado.
es.R: Tú diste {{deity_pronoun:tus|Tus}} instrucciones para que las obedeciéramos con mucho cuidado.

vi.L: Chính {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã truyền các huấn lệnh của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, để giữ [chúng] hết sức cẩn thận.
vi.B: Chính {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã ban các huấn lệnh của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} để được gìn giữ hết sức cẩn thận.
vi.R: Ngài đã ban những lời chỉ dẫn của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} để chúng tôi hết sức cẩn thận vâng theo.

ko.L: 주님께서 주님의 법도들을 명하셨으니, 힘써 지키게 하셨습니다.
ko.B: 주님께서는 주님의 법도를 정하시고, 정성을 다해 지키라고 하셨습니다.
ko.R: 주님께서는 저희가 정성을 다해 따르도록 주님의 지시를 주셨습니다.

decisions.choice: You: the psalm turns to speak to God
decisions.reason: Verses 1-3 speak about God; from here on the psalm speaks to him almost throughout. The pronoun is emphatic: it is God himself who gave these precepts.

decisions.choice: precepts: the charges God has laid down
decisions.reason: The word (piqqudim) is found only in the Psalms. It comes from a verb for appointing or putting in charge, so it means the particular charges God has given. It is one of the psalm's eight words for God's law.
The word (me'od) means "very, greatly"; with "keep" it means keeping them with great care.
Literal and Balanced say "precepts"; Readable says "instructions", a plainer word. The psalm keeps the same wording throughout.
Readable names who is to keep the precepts: God's people.

decisions.choice: piqqudim: "les préceptes" (Literal, Balanced), "les consignes" (Readable), throughout the psalm
decisions.reason: "Préceptes" is the traditional word for the charges God lays down (meaning decision m2). Readable uses the everyday "consignes", things one has been told to do; "instructions" would blur with "l'instruction", the Balanced word for torah.

The Hebrew word (piqqudim) means charges that God has laid on someone. "Maagizo" (charges, instructions given) says this, and keeps it apart from "amri" (commands), which stands for another of the psalm's eight words. It is used throughout.

The Hebrew word (piqqudim) is used for the orders a superior gives in detail. Literal and Balanced say "preceptos"; Readable says "instrucciones", a plainer word, as the English Readable does. The same wording is kept all through the psalm.

decisions.choice: "Ngài" for "you" when the psalmist speaks to God, and "tôi" for himself, through the psalm
decisions.reason: From here the psalm speaks to God (see the meaning decision). As in Psalms 23 and 139, the singer speaks to him as "Ngài", with the deity_pronoun setting the English has, and calls himself "tôi"; "Lạy CHÚA" is used where he calls on the name. Readable adds "chúng tôi" (we) only where the English Readable supplies "we".

decisions.choice: piqqudim is "huấn lệnh" (L, B) and "lời chỉ dẫn" (R) all through the psalm
decisions.reason: The word means the particular charges God has laid down (see the meaning decision). "huấn lệnh" (an order given to instruct) keeps that sense and is kept apart from the psalm's other words for God's law; Readable uses the everyday "lời chỉ dẫn" (instructions), as the English Readable does.

decisions.choice: From here the psalm speaks to God in 합쇼체; the psalmist is "저/제"; God is addressed by title, "주님" (주님께서, 주님의), and called by name with "{{divine_name:주|야훼}}여"
decisions.reason: Style guide section 7a (speech levels in prayer) and Psalm 139. Korean addresses a superior by title, not by a pronoun, so every "you" and "your" for God is "주님". Verses 1-3 speak about God and keep the plain written style.

decisions.choice: piqqudim: "법도" (precepts) at Literal and Balanced; "지시" (instructions) at Readable, throughout the psalm
decisions.reason: "법도" is the word for the rules God has laid down to be kept; Readable uses the plainer "지시", as the English Readable says "instructions". "계명" is kept for mitsvot.

records.literal_gloss: Oh that my ways were firm to keep your statutes!

en.L: Oh that my ways were made firm to keep {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} statutes!
en.B: If only my life were set firmly on keeping {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} statutes!
en.R: I wish I could always be steady in obeying {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} laws!

fr.L: Ah ! si mes voies étaient affermies pour garder {{deity_pronoun:tes|Tes}} prescriptions !
fr.B: Si seulement ma conduite était fermement établie pour garder {{deity_pronoun:tes|Tes}} prescriptions !
fr.R: Comme je voudrais rester toujours ferme pour obéir à {{deity_pronoun:tes|Tes}} lois !

sw.L: Laiti njia zangu zingethibitishwa ili nishike kanuni {{deity_pronoun:zako|Zako}}!
sw.B: Laiti maisha yangu yangesimama imara katika kushika kanuni {{deity_pronoun:zako|Zako}}!
sw.R: Natamani ningekuwa imara siku zote katika kuzitii kanuni {{deity_pronoun:zako|Zako}}!

es.L: ¡Ojalá mis caminos fueran firmes para guardar {{deity_pronoun:tus|Tus}} estatutos!
es.B: ¡Ojalá mi vida estuviera firmemente puesta en cumplir {{deity_pronoun:tus|Tus}} estatutos!
es.R: ¡Cómo quisiera ser siempre constante en obedecer {{deity_pronoun:tus|Tus}} leyes!

vi.L: Ôi, ước gì các đường lối của tôi được vững vàng để giữ các luật lệ của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}!
vi.B: Ước gì đời sống tôi được đặt vững vàng trên việc gìn giữ các luật lệ của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}!
vi.R: Ước gì tôi luôn vững vàng trong việc vâng theo luật lệ của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}!

ko.L: 아, 제 길들이 굳게 세워져 주님의 규례들을 지킬 수 있다면!
ko.B: 제 삶이 주님의 규례를 지키는 일에 굳게 서 있다면 얼마나 좋겠습니까!
ko.R: 제가 언제나 흔들림 없이 주님의 법을 따를 수 있으면 좋겠습니다!

decisions.reason: The word ('achalay) expresses a longing: "if only".
The verb (kun) is to be firm or fixed; the psalmist longs for a life that does not waver.

decisions.choice: statutes: rules that are fixed and laid down
decisions.reason: The word (chuqqim; the related chuqqot in verse 16) comes from a verb for carving or marking out: a rule that stands fixed. It is one of the psalm's eight words for God's law.
Literal and Balanced say "statutes"; Readable says "laws", the everyday word. The psalm keeps the same wording throughout.

decisions.choice: huqqim: "les prescriptions" (Literal, Balanced), "les lois" (Readable), throughout the psalm
decisions.reason: As the Pentateuch terms note has it for statutes: "prescriptions" at Literal and Balanced, the everyday "lois" at Readable, where torah is "l'enseignement" and so cannot be confused with it.
The Hebrew word (huqqim) means rules that are fixed and laid down. "Kanuni" is the word used for statutes in the Pentateuch, and Readable keeps it too, so that the psalm's eight words stay apart.

The Hebrew word (huqqim) is something fixed or engraved, a settled rule. Literal and Balanced say "estatutos", as in the Pentateuch; Readable says "leyes", the everyday word. The same wording is kept all through the psalm.

decisions.choice: chuqqim (and chuqqot) is "luật lệ" at every level, all through the psalm
decisions.reason: The word is a rule that stands fixed (see the meaning decision). "luật lệ" (laws and rules) is plain enough for Readable as well, so every level keeps it, matching the English Readable "laws"; it is kept apart from "lời dạy" for torah.

decisions.choice: huqqim: "규례" (statutes) at Literal and Balanced; "법" (laws) at Readable, throughout the psalm
decisions.reason: "규례" is the plain modern word for fixed rules; "율례" is older church language. Readable says "법", the everyday word, as the English Readable says "laws".

records.literal_gloss: Then not I will be ashamed, when I look to all your commands.

en.L: Then I will not be put to shame, when I look to all {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} commands.
en.B: Then I will not be put to shame, as I keep my eyes on all {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} commands.
en.R: Then I will not be ashamed, because I will pay attention to all {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} commands.

fr.L: Alors je ne serai pas couvert de honte, quand je regarderai vers tous {{deity_pronoun:tes|Tes}} commandements.
fr.B: Alors je ne serai pas couvert de honte, si je garde les yeux fixés sur tous {{deity_pronoun:tes|Tes}} commandements.
fr.R: Alors je n’aurai pas honte, car je ferai attention à tous {{deity_pronoun:tes|Tes}} commandements.

sw.L: Ndipo sitaaibishwa, nitakapozitazama amri {{deity_pronoun:zako|Zako}} zote.
sw.B: Ndipo sitaaibika, macho yangu yakiwa juu ya amri {{deity_pronoun:zako|Zako}} zote.
sw.R: Ndipo sitaona aibu, kwa sababu nitazijali amri {{deity_pronoun:zako|Zako}} zote.

es.L: Entonces no me avergonzaré, cuando mire a todos {{deity_pronoun:tus|Tus}} mandamientos.
es.B: Entonces no pasaré vergüenza, si tengo la vista puesta en todos {{deity_pronoun:tus|Tus}} mandamientos.
es.R: Entonces no tendré de qué avergonzarme, porque prestaré atención a todos {{deity_pronoun:tus|Tus}} mandamientos.

vi.L: Khi ấy tôi sẽ không bị hổ thẹn, khi tôi chú mắt vào mọi điều răn của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.
vi.B: Khi ấy tôi sẽ không bị hổ thẹn, vì tôi luôn để mắt đến mọi điều răn của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.
vi.R: Khi ấy tôi sẽ không phải xấu hổ, vì tôi sẽ chú ý đến mọi điều răn của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.

ko.L: 그러면 제가 부끄러움을 당하지 않을 것입니다, 주님의 모든 계명들을 바라볼 때에.
ko.B: 그러면 주님의 모든 계명에 늘 눈을 두는 저는 부끄러움을 당하지 않을 것입니다.
ko.R: 그러면 저는 부끄러운 일을 당하지 않을 것입니다. 주님의 모든 명령에 귀를 기울일 것이기 때문입니다.

decisions.choice: be put to shame: be disgraced, be let down
decisions.reason: The verb (bosh) is to be disgraced, often by finding that what one trusted has failed.

decisions.choice: look to: pay attention to, consider
decisions.reason: The verb (hibbit) is to look at something closely and take it to heart.

decisions.choice: commands: what God has told his people to do
decisions.reason: The word (mitsvot) comes from the verb "command" used in verse 4. It is one of the psalm's eight words for God's law.

decisions.choice: mitsvot: "les commandements" at every level, throughout the psalm
decisions.reason: The common word for what God has told his people to do, plain enough for Readable as well.
"Amri" is the word for the commandments in the Pentateuch and in Proverbs, and it is kept for this word (mitswah) throughout the psalm.
The Hebrew word (mitsvot) is a command God gives. Spanish says "mandamientos" at every level, the word used for God's commands elsewhere, and keeps it all through the psalm.

decisions.choice: mitsvot is "điều răn" at every level, all through the psalm
decisions.reason: "điều răn" (commandment) is the word used for God's commands in John and Proverbs, and it is clear at every level, so the psalm keeps it throughout.

decisions.choice: mitsvot: "계명" (commands) at Literal and Balanced; "명령" at Readable, throughout the psalm
decisions.reason: "계명" is the familiar word for God's commands; Readable says "명령", the everyday word for a command.

source.text: א֭וֹדְךָ בְּיֹ֣שֶׁר לֵבָ֑ב בְּ֝לָמְדִ֗י מִשְׁפְּטֵ֥י צִדְקֶֽךָ׃

records.literal_gloss: I will thank you with uprightness of heart, when I learn [the] judgments of your righteousness.

en.L: I will give thanks to {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} with uprightness of heart, when I learn the judgments of {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} righteousness.
en.B: With an honest heart I will give {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} thanks, as I come to learn {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} righteous rulings.
en.R: When I learn {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} decisions, which are always right, I will thank {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} with an honest heart.

fr.L: Je {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} rendrai grâce avec droiture de cœur, quand j’apprendrai les jugements de {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} justice.
fr.B: Avec un cœur honnête je {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} rendrai grâce, à mesure que j’apprendrai {{deity_pronoun:tes|Tes}} justes décisions.
fr.R: Quand j’apprendrai {{deity_pronoun:tes|Tes}} décisions, qui sont toujours justes, je {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} remercierai avec un cœur honnête.

sw.L: Nitakushukuru kwa unyofu wa moyo, nitakapojifunza hukumu za haki {{deity_pronoun:yako|Yako}}.
sw.B: Kwa moyo mnyofu nitakushukuru, ninapojifunza hukumu {{deity_pronoun:zako|Zako}} za haki.
sw.R: Ninapojifunza hukumu {{deity_pronoun:zako|Zako}}, ambazo ni za haki siku zote, nitakushukuru kwa moyo mnyofu.

es.L: Te daré gracias con rectitud de corazón, cuando aprenda los juicios de {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} justicia.
es.B: Con un corazón sincero {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} daré gracias, a medida que aprenda {{deity_pronoun:tus|Tus}} justos dictámenes.
es.R: Cuando aprenda {{deity_pronoun:tus|Tus}} decisiones, que siempre son justas, {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} daré gracias con un corazón sincero.

vi.L: Tôi sẽ cảm tạ {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} với lòng ngay thẳng, khi tôi học các phán quyết [theo] sự công chính của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.
vi.B: Tôi sẽ cảm tạ {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} với tấm lòng chân thật, khi tôi học biết các phán quyết công chính của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.
vi.R: Khi tôi học biết những quyết định của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, là những quyết định luôn luôn đúng, tôi sẽ cảm tạ {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} với tấm lòng chân thật.

ko.L: 제가 주님의 의의 판결들을 배울 때에, 정직한 마음으로 주님께 감사하겠습니다.
ko.B: 주님의 의로운 판결을 배워 갈 때, 저는 정직한 마음으로 주님께 감사드리겠습니다.
ko.R: 언제나 옳은 주님의 결정을 배울 때, 저는 진실한 마음으로 주님께 감사드리겠습니다.

decisions.reason: The verb (hodah) is to give thanks by saying openly what God has done.

decisions.choice: judgments: God's rulings, his decisions about what is right
decisions.reason: The word (mishpatim) is a judge's verdict: the decisions God has made about what is right, which then guide how people live (Exodus 21:1). It is one of the psalm's eight words for God's law.

decisions.choice: judgments of your righteousness: your righteous rulings
decisions.reason: The second noun describes the first: rulings that are right and just.
"Judgments" can sound like punishments, so Balanced says "rulings" and Readable "decisions", which keep the sense of a judge's verdict. The psalm keeps the same wording throughout.

decisions.choice: mishpatim: "les jugements" (Literal), "les décisions" (Balanced, Readable), throughout the psalm
decisions.reason: "Jugements" can sound like punishments, as the English "judgments" can, so Balanced and Readable say "décisions", a judge's rulings about what is right (meaning decision m2). French uses one word for both levels where the English has "rulings" and "decisions".

"Hukumu" is a judge's ruling or verdict, the sense of the Hebrew word (mishpatim) here (m2). Unlike English "judgment", it does not mainly suggest punishment, so Swahili can keep one word at every level where the English moves from "judgments" to "rulings" and "decisions". Where the word means justice or custom instead (verses 121, 132, 149), the sense is followed.

The Hebrew word (mishpatim) is a judge's ruling. Literal keeps "juicios"; since that can sound like a trial or a punishment, Balanced says "dictámenes" and Readable "decisiones", which keep the sense of a judge's verdict. "Sentencias" was not used because it usually means a condemnation. The same wording is kept all through the psalm.

decisions.choice: mishpatim is "phán quyết" (L, B) and "quyết định" (R) all through the psalm
decisions.reason: The word is a judge's verdict, God's rulings about what is right (see the meaning decision). "sự phán xét" can sound like judgement as punishment, as the English decision says of "judgments"; "phán quyết" is a ruling, and Readable says "quyết định" (decisions), as the English Readable does. Where the word means justice or a custom, the sense is followed and a decision says so.

decisions.choice: mishpatim: "판결" (rulings) at Literal and Balanced; "결정" (decisions) at Readable, throughout the psalm
decisions.reason: The word is a judge's verdict, here God's rulings on what is right (English decision). "심판" would sound like a judgment of punishment, and "규례" is kept for huqqim. Readable says "결정", as the English Readable says "decisions".

records.literal_gloss: Your statutes I will keep; do not forsake me up to muchness.

en.L: Your statutes I will keep; do not forsake me utterly.
en.B: I will hold to {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} statutes; do not leave me wholly alone.
en.R: I will obey {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} laws. Please do not leave me on my own for good.

fr.L: Tes prescriptions, je [les] garderai ; ne m’abandonne pas entièrement.
fr.B: Je m’attacherai à {{deity_pronoun:tes|Tes}} prescriptions ; ne me laisse pas complètement seul.
fr.R: J’obéirai à {{deity_pronoun:tes|Tes}} lois. S’il {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} plaît, ne me laisse pas seul pour toujours.

sw.L: Kanuni {{deity_pronoun:zako|Zako}} nitazishika; usiniache kabisa.
sw.B: Nitazishika kanuni {{deity_pronoun:zako|Zako}}; usiniache peke yangu kabisa.
sw.R: Nitazitii kanuni {{deity_pronoun:zako|Zako}}. Tafadhali usiniache peke yangu milele.

es.L: Tus estatutos guardaré; no me desampares del todo.
es.B: Me mantendré fiel a {{deity_pronoun:tus|Tus}} estatutos; no me dejes en total abandono.
es.R: Obedeceré {{deity_pronoun:tus|Tus}} leyes. Por favor, no me dejes por mi cuenta para siempre.

vi.L: Các luật lệ của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, tôi sẽ giữ; xin đừng lìa bỏ tôi hoàn toàn.
vi.B: Tôi sẽ giữ vững các luật lệ của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}; xin đừng hoàn toàn bỏ mặc tôi một mình.
vi.R: Tôi sẽ vâng theo luật lệ của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}. Xin đừng bỏ tôi lại một mình mãi mãi.

ko.L: 주님의 규례들을 제가 지키겠습니다. 저를 아주 버리지 마십시오.
ko.B: 저는 주님의 규례를 굳게 지키겠습니다. 저를 아주 홀로 내버려 두지 마십시오.
ko.R: 저는 주님의 법을 따르겠습니다. 제발 저를 영영 혼자 내버려 두지 마십시오.

decisions.choice: statutes: rules that are fixed and laid down
decisions.reason: As in 119:5.
The phrase ("up to muchness") means "to the full". The psalmist does not deny that trouble may come, but asks not to be left without God altogether.

decisions.choice: do not leave me on my own for good
decisions.reason: Readable says plainly what the request means.

records.literal_gloss: By what will a youth keep his path pure? By keeping [it] according to your word.

en.L: By what will {{gender:a young person|a young man}} keep {{gender:their|his}} path pure? By keeping watch [over it] according to {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} word.
en.B: How can the young keep their way of life clean? By taking care to live as {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} word directs.
en.R: How can young people keep their lives pure? They must watch how they live and do what {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} word says.

fr.L: Par quoi {{gender:le jeune|le jeune homme}} gardera-t-il pur son sentier ? En [y] veillant selon {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} parole.
fr.B: Comment les jeunes garderont-ils leur conduite pure ? En prenant soin de vivre comme {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} parole l’indique.
fr.R: Comment les jeunes peuvent-ils garder une vie pure ? Ils doivent faire attention à leur façon de vivre et faire ce que dit {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} parole.

sw.L: Kwa kitu gani kijana ataitunza njia yake iwe safi? Kwa kuilinda kulingana na neno {{deity_pronoun:lako|Lako}}.
sw.B: Vijana wanawezaje kuweka mwenendo wao safi? Kwa kuwa waangalifu kuishi kama neno {{deity_pronoun:lako|Lako}} linavyoelekeza.
sw.R: Vijana wanawezaje kuweka maisha yao safi? Lazima waangalie jinsi wanavyoishi na kufanya yale ambayo neno {{deity_pronoun:lako|Lako}} linasema.

es.L: ¿Con qué mantendrá {{gender:una persona joven|un joven}} puro su sendero? Vigilando [su sendero] conforme a {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} palabra.
es.B: ¿Cómo pueden los jóvenes mantener limpia su manera de vivir? Cuidando de vivir como {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} palabra indica.
es.R: ¿Cómo pueden los jóvenes mantener pura su vida? Tienen que cuidar cómo viven y hacer lo que dice {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} palabra.

vi.L: Nhờ đâu người trẻ giữ cho đường lối mình trong sạch? Nhờ canh giữ [nó] theo lời của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.
vi.B: Làm sao người trẻ giữ cho nếp sống mình trong sạch? Bằng cách cẩn thận sống theo lời của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.
vi.R: Làm sao người trẻ có thể giữ đời sống mình trong sạch? Họ phải coi chừng cách mình sống và làm theo lời của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.

ko.L: 젊은이가 무엇으로 자기 길을 깨끗하게 지키겠습니까? 주님의 말씀을 따라 [그 길을] 살펴 지킴으로써입니다.
ko.B: 젊은이들이 어떻게 자기 삶을 깨끗하게 지킬 수 있겠습니까? 주님의 말씀이 이르는 대로 조심하여 사는 것입니다.
ko.R: 젊은 사람들이 어떻게 깨끗하게 살 수 있겠습니까? 자기가 사는 모습을 잘 살피고 주님의 말씀대로 해야 합니다.

decisions.reason: Each of the eight verses of this stanza begins with the letter beth, the second letter of the Hebrew alphabet (see 119:1).
The word (na'ar) is masculine and means a boy or young man, but the question is asked for anyone young setting out in life, as in Proverbs 1:4.

decisions.choice: keep pure: keep clean, free of wrong
decisions.reason: The verb (zakah) is to be clean or pure, here of a way of life.
The verse asks a question and answers it: by keeping watch over one's path as God's word directs.
The word (davar) is anything spoken; here it is what God has said to his people. It is one of the psalm's eight words for God's law.

decisions.choice: a young person ... their; "a young man ... his" as the alternative
decisions.reason: The question is for anyone young (m2), so the gender setting gives inclusive wording by default.
Balanced and Readable say it in the plural, which needs no setting.

decisions.choice: davar: "la parole" (plural "les paroles") at every level, throughout the psalm
decisions.reason: The plain word for what God has spoken (meaning decision m5), used for davar wherever the psalm has it.

decisions.choice: gender setting on the noun only: "le jeune", with "le jeune homme" as the alternative; no setting on "il" or "son"
alternatives: a span on the pronoun as in the English
decisions.reason: French writes the setting on the noun; the pronoun that refers back to it is ordinary generic French. Balanced and Readable say "les jeunes", which needs no setting.
"Neno" is the plain word for what God has spoken (davar), and it is kept for this word throughout the psalm.

alternatives: a gender span as in the English Literal
decisions.reason: "Kijana" is any young person, and "yake" (his or her) has no gender, so the Swahili already says what the English inclusive wording says and the setting has nothing to change.

The Hebrew word (naʿar) means a young man, but the verse speaks of any young person, as the English default does. "Una persona joven" is the default and "un joven" the reader's alternative; "su" already says nothing about gender. Balanced and Readable say "los jóvenes", which covers both.
The Hebrew davar ("word") is "palabra" at every level and all through the psalm, so that it can be told from the other words for God's teaching.

decisions.choice: davar is "lời" (word) at every level, all through the psalm
decisions.reason: "lời" is the plain word for what God has said; "lời phán" is kept for the psalm's other word, 'imrah, so that the two can be told apart as the English tells "word" from "saying" and "promise".

decisions.choice: "người trẻ" (a young person) with no gender span
alternatives: a gender span as in the English ("chàng trai trẻ" as the alternative)
decisions.reason: "người trẻ" already means anyone young, and Vietnamese needs no pronoun after it, so there is no second form for the gender setting to switch to, as in Psalm 1:1.

decisions.choice: davar: "말씀" (word) at every level, throughout the psalm
decisions.reason: God's word takes the honorific noun "말씀". It is kept for davar; 'imrah has its own wording (verse 11).

decisions.choice: "젊은이" (a young person) with no gender span
alternatives: a gender span with "젊은이" by default and "청년" (young man) as the alternative
decisions.reason: The English offers "a young man" as an alternative. Korean "젊은이" covers young people of either sex and needs no possessive pronoun ("자기 길"), so Korean has no second wording to offer (style guide section 7).

records.literal_gloss: With all my heart I have sought you; do not let me stray from your commands.

en.L: With all my heart I have sought {{deity_pronoun:you|You}}; do not let me wander from {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} commands.
en.B: I have searched for {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} with all my heart; do not let me drift away from {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} commands.
en.R: I have looked for {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} with all my heart. Do not let me wander away from {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} commands.

fr.L: De tout mon cœur je {{deity_pronoun:t’|T’}}ai cherché ; ne me laisse pas m’égarer loin de {{deity_pronoun:tes|Tes}} commandements.
fr.B: Je {{deity_pronoun:t’|T’}}ai cherché de tout mon cœur ; ne me laisse pas dériver loin de {{deity_pronoun:tes|Tes}} commandements.
fr.R: Je {{deity_pronoun:t’|T’}}ai cherché de tout mon cœur. Ne me laisse pas m’éloigner de {{deity_pronoun:tes|Tes}} commandements.

sw.L: Kwa moyo wangu wote nimekutafuta; usiniache nipotee mbali na amri {{deity_pronoun:zako|Zako}}.
sw.B: Nimekutafuta kwa moyo wangu wote; usiniache nitangetange mbali na amri {{deity_pronoun:zako|Zako}}.
sw.R: Nimekutafuta kwa moyo wangu wote. Usiniache nipotee nikaziacha amri {{deity_pronoun:zako|Zako}}.

es.L: Con todo mi corazón {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} he buscado; no me dejes desviarme de {{deity_pronoun:tus|Tus}} mandamientos.
es.B: Te he buscado con todo mi corazón; no permitas que me aparte de {{deity_pronoun:tus|Tus}} mandamientos.
es.R: Te he buscado con todo mi corazón. No dejes que me aleje de {{deity_pronoun:tus|Tus}} mandamientos.

vi.L: Với trọn lòng tôi, tôi đã tìm kiếm {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}; xin đừng để tôi lạc khỏi các điều răn của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.
vi.B: Tôi đã hết lòng tìm kiếm {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}; xin đừng để tôi trôi dạt xa các điều răn của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.
vi.R: Tôi đã hết lòng tìm kiếm {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}. Xin đừng để tôi đi lạc xa các điều răn của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.

ko.L: 제 온 마음으로 제가 주님을 찾았습니다. 주님의 계명들에서 저를 벗어나지 않게 하십시오.
ko.B: 제가 온 마음을 다해 주님을 찾았으니, 주님의 계명에서 떠나 헤매지 않게 하여 주십시오.
ko.R: 저는 온 마음으로 주님을 찾았습니다. 제가 주님의 명령에서 떠나 헤매지 않게 해 주십시오.

decisions.choice: sought you: turned to God, wanted him
decisions.reason: As in 119:2.

decisions.choice: wander: go astray, stray by mistake
decisions.reason: The verb (shagah) is used of straying without meaning to, as a sheep wanders off. The psalmist asks God to keep him from it.

decisions.choice: commands: what God has told his people to do
decisions.reason: As in 119:6.

source.text: בְּ֭לִבִּי צָפַ֣נְתִּי אִמְרָתֶ֑ךָ לְ֝מַ֗עַן לֹ֣א אֶֽחֱטָא־לָֽךְ׃

records.literal_gloss: In my heart I have hidden your saying, so that I may not sin against you.

en.L: In my heart I have hidden {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} saying, so that I may not sin against {{deity_pronoun:you|You}}.
en.B: Deep in my heart I have kept {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} word safe, so that I will not sin against {{deity_pronoun:you|You}}.
en.R: I keep what {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} said close in my heart, to keep me from sinning against {{deity_pronoun:you|You}}.

fr.L: Dans mon cœur j’ai caché {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} propos, afin de ne pas pécher contre {{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}}.
fr.B: Au fond de mon cœur j’ai mis {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} parole à l’abri, pour ne pas pécher contre {{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}}.
fr.R: Je garde près de mon cœur ce que {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} as dit, pour ne pas pécher contre {{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}}.

sw.L: Moyoni mwangu nimeihifadhi kauli {{deity_pronoun:yako|Yako}}, ili nisitende dhambi dhidi {{deity_pronoun:yako|Yako}}.
sw.B: Nimeitunza kauli {{deity_pronoun:yako|Yako}} ndani kabisa ya moyo wangu, ili nisitende dhambi dhidi {{deity_pronoun:yako|Yako}}.
sw.R: Ninaiweka kauli {{deity_pronoun:yako|Yako}} karibu moyoni mwangu, inizuie nisitende dhambi dhidi {{deity_pronoun:yako|Yako}}.

es.L: En mi corazón he escondido {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} dicho, para no pecar contra {{deity_pronoun:ti|Ti}}.
es.B: En lo hondo de mi corazón he guardado {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} palabra, para no pecar contra {{deity_pronoun:ti|Ti}}.
es.R: Guardo en mi corazón lo que {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} dijiste, para no pecar contra {{deity_pronoun:ti|Ti}}.

vi.L: Trong lòng tôi, tôi đã giấu lời phán của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, để tôi không phạm tội cùng {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.
vi.B: Tôi đã cất giữ lời phán của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} sâu trong lòng, để tôi không phạm tội cùng {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.
vi.R: Tôi giữ những điều {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã phán ở trong lòng, để khỏi phạm tội với {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.

ko.L: 제 마음에 주님께서 하신 말씀을 숨겨 두었습니다, 주님께 죄를 짓지 않으려고.
ko.B: 제가 주님께 죄를 짓지 않으려고, 주님의 말씀을 제 마음 깊이 소중히 간직하였습니다.
ko.R: 저는 주님께서 하신 말씀을 마음에 꼭 품고 있습니다. 그래야 주님께 죄를 짓지 않을 것입니다.

decisions.reason: The verb (tsafan) is to hide something away to keep it safe, as treasure is hidden (Proverbs 2:1; 10:14).

decisions.choice: saying: what God has said, often his promise
decisions.reason: The word ('imrah) comes from the verb "say": what God has said. In this psalm it often means a promise God has made (verses 38, 41, 50). It is one of the psalm's eight words for God's law.

decisions.choice: saying (L); promise, or word where no promise is in view (B); promise, or what you said (R)
decisions.reason: Literal keeps a word of its own for 'imrah, so that it can be told apart from davar ("word"). Balanced and Readable say "promise" where a promise is in view, and otherwise "word" (Balanced) or "what you said" (Readable).

decisions.choice: 'imrah: "le propos" (Literal); "la promesse" where a promise is in view, otherwise "la parole" (Balanced); "ta promesse", "ce que tu as promis" or "ce que tu as dit" (Readable), throughout the psalm
decisions.reason: Literal needs a word of its own for 'imrah so that it can be told apart from davar, "la parole". "Le propos", what someone has said, is the closest French noun, but it is rarely used of God; a reviewer may prefer another. Balanced and Readable follow the English: a promise where a promise is in view, a word where it is not.

alternatives: "ahadi" (promise) where a promise is in view
decisions.reason: "Kauli" is what someone has said and stands by, so it can mean God's saying and also his promise, which covers both senses of 'imrah (m2). One word at every level keeps it apart from "neno" (davar), where the English moves between "saying", "word" and "promise". A reviewer may prefer "ahadi" where a promise is plainly in view.

decisions.choice: dicho (L); promesa, or palabra where no promise is in view (B); promesa, or lo que dijiste (R)
decisions.reason: Literal gives the Hebrew ʾimrah ("saying") a word of its own, "dicho", so that it can be told apart from davar ("palabra"). Balanced and Readable follow the English: "promesa" where God's word is a promise, and otherwise "palabra" (Balanced) or "lo que dijiste" (Readable).

decisions.choice: 'imrah is "lời phán" (L); "lời hứa" where a promise is in view, otherwise "lời phán" (B) or "điều Ngài đã phán" (R)
decisions.reason: The word is what God has said, often a promise (see the meaning decision). Literal keeps one word for it, "lời phán", apart from "lời" for davar; Balanced and Readable say "lời hứa" (promise) wherever the English does, so the two words stay distinct at every level.

decisions.choice: 'imrah: "하신 말씀" (what you said) at Literal; "약속" where a promise is in view, otherwise "말씀" (Balanced); "약속하신 것" or "하신 말씀" (Readable), throughout the psalm
decisions.reason: Literal keeps a wording of its own for 'imrah so that it can be told apart from davar ("말씀"), as the English Literal keeps "saying". God's speech takes the honorific, so Korean says "주님께서 하신 말씀" rather than a bare noun. Balanced and Readable follow the English: a promise where one is in view. "언약" is kept for covenant.

records.literal_gloss: Blessed [are] you, YHWH; teach me your statutes.

en.L: Blessed [are] {{deity_pronoun:you|You}}, {{divine_name:LORD|Yahweh}}; teach me {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} statutes.
en.B: All praise to {{deity_pronoun:you|You}}, {{divine_name:LORD|Yahweh}}! Teach me {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} statutes.
en.R: {{divine_name:LORD|Yahweh}}, I praise {{deity_pronoun:you|You}}! Teach me {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} laws.

fr.L: [Tu es] béni, {{divine_name:SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} ; enseigne-moi {{deity_pronoun:tes|Tes}} prescriptions.
fr.B: Louange à {{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}}, {{divine_name:SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} ! Enseigne-moi {{deity_pronoun:tes|Tes}} prescriptions.
fr.R: {{divine_name:SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, je {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} loue ! Enseigne-moi {{deity_pronoun:tes|Tes}} lois.

sw.L: Umebarikiwa {{deity_pronoun:wewe|Wewe}}, Ee {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}; unifundishe kanuni {{deity_pronoun:zako|Zako}}.
sw.B: Sifa zote ni {{deity_pronoun:zako|Zako}}, Ee {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}! Unifundishe kanuni {{deity_pronoun:zako|Zako}}.
sw.R: Ee {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, ninakusifu! Unifundishe kanuni {{deity_pronoun:zako|Zako}}.

es.L: Bendito [eres] {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}}, {{divine_name:SEÑOR|Yahvé}}; enséñame {{deity_pronoun:tus|Tus}} estatutos.
es.B: ¡Toda alabanza a {{deity_pronoun:ti|Ti}}, {{divine_name:SEÑOR|Yahvé}}! Enséñame {{deity_pronoun:tus|Tus}} estatutos.
es.R: {{divine_name:SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, ¡{{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} alabo! Enséñame {{deity_pronoun:tus|Tus}} leyes.

vi.L: Ngài [thật] đáng được chúc tụng, lạy {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}; xin dạy tôi các luật lệ của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.
vi.B: Lạy {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, nguyện mọi lời chúc tụng thuộc về {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}! Xin dạy tôi các luật lệ của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.
vi.R: Lạy {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, tôi ca ngợi {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}! Xin dạy tôi luật lệ của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.

ko.L: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}여, 주님은 송축받으실 분이십니다. 주님의 규례들을 저에게 가르쳐 주십시오.
ko.B: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}여, 주님을 송축합니다! 주님의 규례를 저에게 가르쳐 주십시오.
ko.R: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}여, 주님을 찬양합니다! 주님의 법을 저에게 가르쳐 주십시오.

decisions.reason: This is a different word from "How blessed" in verses 1-2: baruk, said of God, means that he is praised and thanked (28:6; 41:14).

decisions.choice: statutes: rules that are fixed and laid down
decisions.reason: As in 119:5.

decisions.choice: teach me your statutes: a request the psalm repeats
decisions.reason: The same request comes again in verses 26, 64, 68 and later in the psalm.
To bless God is to praise him (송축하다, as the terms note); "복되다" would say that God receives good fortune. Readable uses the everyday "찬양하다", as the English Readable says "praise".

records.literal_gloss: With my lips I recount all [the] judgments of your mouth.

en.L: With my lips I recount all the judgments of {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} mouth.
en.B: Aloud I tell over every ruling {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} have spoken.
en.R: I say out loud all the decisions {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} have spoken.

fr.L: De mes lèvres je raconte tous les jugements de {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} bouche.
fr.B: À voix haute j’énumère chaque décision que {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} as prononcée.
fr.R: Je redis à voix haute toutes les décisions que {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} as prononcées.

sw.L: Kwa midomo yangu ninazisimulia hukumu zote za kinywa {{deity_pronoun:chako|Chako}}.
sw.B: Kwa sauti ninazitaja moja moja hukumu zote ulizozinena.
sw.R: Ninazitamka kwa sauti hukumu zote ulizozisema.

es.L: Con mis labios cuento todos los juicios de {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} boca.
es.B: En voz alta repaso cada dictamen que {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} has pronunciado.
es.R: Digo en voz alta todas las decisiones que {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} has dado.

vi.L: Bằng môi tôi, tôi thuật lại mọi phán quyết từ miệng {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.
vi.B: Tôi cất tiếng kể lại từng phán quyết {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã phán ra.
vi.R: Tôi nói lớn tiếng mọi quyết định {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã phán.

ko.L: 제 입술로 주님의 입의 모든 판결들을 낱낱이 말합니다.
ko.B: 주님께서 말씀하신 모든 판결을 저는 소리 내어 하나하나 되뇝니다.
ko.R: 주님께서 말씀하신 모든 결정을 저는 소리 내어 말합니다.

decisions.choice: recount: tell over, list one by one
decisions.reason: The verb (sipper) is to count out or tell in order.

decisions.choice: judgments: God's rulings, his decisions about what is right
decisions.reason: As in 119:7.

decisions.choice: of your mouth: that you have spoken
decisions.reason: God's mouth stands for what he has said.
Balanced and Readable say what the picture means.

records.literal_gloss: In [the] way of your testimonies I rejoice, as over all wealth.

en.L: In the way of {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} testimonies I rejoice, as over all riches.
en.B: Following {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} decrees gives me as much joy as all the riches in the world.
en.R: Living by what {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} have declared makes me as happy as if I owned great riches.

fr.L: Dans la voie de {{deity_pronoun:tes|Tes}} témoignages je me réjouis, comme pour toutes les richesses.
fr.B: Suivre {{deity_pronoun:tes|Tes}} décrets me donne autant de joie que toutes les richesses du monde.
fr.R: Vivre selon ce que {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} as déclaré me rend aussi heureux que si j’avais de grandes richesses.

sw.L: Katika njia ya shuhuda {{deity_pronoun:zako|Zako}} ninashangilia, kama juu ya mali zote.
sw.B: Kufuata shuhuda {{deity_pronoun:zako|Zako}} kunanifurahisha kama utajiri wote wa dunia.
sw.R: Kuishi kwa shuhuda {{deity_pronoun:zako|Zako}} kunanipa furaha kana kwamba nina mali nyingi sana.

es.L: En el camino de {{deity_pronoun:tus|Tus}} testimonios me regocijo, como por todas las riquezas.
es.B: Seguir {{deity_pronoun:tus|Tus}} decretos me da tanta alegría como todas las riquezas del mundo.
es.R: Vivir según lo que {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} has declarado me hace tan feliz como si tuviera grandes riquezas.

vi.L: Tôi vui mừng trong đường lối các lời chứng của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, như [vui] trên mọi của cải.
vi.B: Việc đi theo các lời chứng của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đem lại cho tôi niềm vui bằng cả mọi của cải trên đời.
vi.R: Sống theo những điều {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã công bố làm tôi vui như thể tôi có rất nhiều của cải.

ko.L: 주님의 증언들의 길에서 제가 기뻐합니다, 모든 재물을 [기뻐하는 것]처럼.
ko.B: 주님의 증언을 따르는 것이 온 세상의 재물만큼이나 저를 기쁘게 합니다.
ko.R: 주님께서 알려 주신 뜻대로 사는 것이 큰 재산을 가진 것처럼 저를 행복하게 합니다.

decisions.choice: testimonies: what God has solemnly declared
decisions.reason: As in 119:2.

decisions.choice: as over all wealth: as much as over every kind of riches
decisions.reason: The comparison means the psalmist is as glad as a person who had all wealth.
Balanced and Readable say what being in the way of the decrees means.

records.literal_gloss: On your precepts I will meditate, and I will look at your paths.

en.L: On {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} precepts I will meditate, and I will look closely at {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} paths.
en.B: I will think deeply about {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} precepts and keep my eyes on {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} ways.
en.R: I will think deeply about {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} instructions and pay attention to {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} ways.

fr.L: Sur {{deity_pronoun:tes|Tes}} préceptes je méditerai, et je regarderai attentivement {{deity_pronoun:tes|Tes}} sentiers.
fr.B: Je réfléchirai profondément à {{deity_pronoun:tes|Tes}} préceptes et je garderai les yeux sur {{deity_pronoun:tes|Tes}} chemins.
fr.R: Je réfléchirai profondément à {{deity_pronoun:tes|Tes}} consignes et je ferai attention à {{deity_pronoun:tes|Tes}} chemins.

sw.L: Juu ya maagizo {{deity_pronoun:yako|Yako}} nitatafakari, na nitazitazama kwa makini njia {{deity_pronoun:zako|Zako}}.
sw.B: Nitayatafakari kwa kina maagizo {{deity_pronoun:yako|Yako}} na kuyaelekeza macho yangu kwenye njia {{deity_pronoun:zako|Zako}}.
sw.R: Nitayafikiria sana maagizo {{deity_pronoun:yako|Yako}} na kuzijali njia {{deity_pronoun:zako|Zako}}.

es.L: En {{deity_pronoun:tus|Tus}} preceptos meditaré, y miraré con atención {{deity_pronoun:tus|Tus}} sendas.
es.B: Pensaré a fondo en {{deity_pronoun:tus|Tus}} preceptos y tendré la vista puesta en {{deity_pronoun:tus|Tus}} caminos.
es.R: Pensaré mucho en {{deity_pronoun:tus|Tus}} instrucciones y prestaré atención a {{deity_pronoun:tus|Tus}} caminos.

vi.L: Tôi sẽ suy ngẫm các huấn lệnh của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, và tôi sẽ chăm nhìn các lối đi của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.
vi.B: Tôi sẽ suy nghĩ sâu xa về các huấn lệnh của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} và để mắt đến các đường lối của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.
vi.R: Tôi sẽ suy nghĩ kỹ về những lời chỉ dẫn của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} và chú ý đến đường lối của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.

ko.L: 주님의 법도들을 제가 묵상하고, 주님의 길들을 눈여겨보겠습니다.
ko.B: 저는 주님의 법도를 깊이 생각하고, 주님의 길에 눈을 두겠습니다.
ko.R: 저는 주님의 지시를 곰곰이 생각하고, 주님의 길에 마음을 쏟겠습니다.

decisions.choice: precepts: the charges God has laid down
decisions.reason: As in 119:4.

decisions.choice: meditate: think over, ponder, talk over
decisions.reason: The verb (siach) is to think something over, often aloud. It comes again in verses 23, 27, 48 and 78.

decisions.choice: look closely at: pay attention to
decisions.reason: As at 119:6.

decisions.choice: "묵상하다" (L), "깊이 생각하다" (B), "곰곰이 생각하다" (R) for the verb of meditating, throughout the psalm
decisions.reason: The verb (siach) is turning a thing over in the mind; Literal keeps the familiar "묵상하다", Balanced and Readable say it in plain words, as the English does ("meditate", "think deeply").

records.literal_gloss: In your statutes I will delight myself; I will not forget your word.

en.L: In {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} statutes I will delight; I will not forget {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} word.
en.B: Your statutes are my joy; I will not let {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} word slip from my mind.
en.R: I enjoy {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} laws. I will not forget {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} word.

fr.L: Dans {{deity_pronoun:tes|Tes}} prescriptions je trouverai mes délices ; je n’oublierai pas {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} parole.
fr.B: Tes prescriptions font ma joie ; je ne laisserai pas {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} parole sortir de ma mémoire.
fr.R: J’aime beaucoup {{deity_pronoun:tes|Tes}} lois. Je n’oublierai pas {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} parole.

sw.L: Katika kanuni {{deity_pronoun:zako|Zako}} nitajifurahisha; sitalisahau neno {{deity_pronoun:lako|Lako}}.
sw.B: Kanuni {{deity_pronoun:zako|Zako}} ni furaha yangu; sitaliacha neno {{deity_pronoun:lako|Lako}} litoke akilini mwangu.
sw.R: Ninazifurahia kanuni {{deity_pronoun:zako|Zako}}. Sitalisahau neno {{deity_pronoun:lako|Lako}}.

es.L: En {{deity_pronoun:tus|Tus}} estatutos me deleitaré; no olvidaré {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} palabra.
es.B: Tus estatutos son mi alegría; no dejaré que {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} palabra se me borre de la mente.
es.R: Disfruto de {{deity_pronoun:tus|Tus}} leyes. No olvidaré {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} palabra.

vi.L: Tôi sẽ vui thích trong các luật lệ của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}; tôi sẽ không quên lời của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.
vi.B: Các luật lệ của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} là niềm vui của tôi; tôi sẽ không để lời của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} phai khỏi trí nhớ.
vi.R: Tôi thích luật lệ của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}. Tôi sẽ không quên lời của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.

ko.L: 주님의 규례들 안에서 제가 즐거워하고, 주님의 말씀을 잊지 않겠습니다.
ko.B: 주님의 규례는 저의 기쁨이니, 주님의 말씀을 마음에서 놓치지 않겠습니다.
ko.R: 저는 주님의 법이 좋습니다. 주님의 말씀을 잊지 않겠습니다.

decisions.choice: statutes: rules that are fixed and laid down
decisions.reason: As in 119:5. Here the Hebrew has the related feminine form (chuqqot), with the same meaning.
The verb (hishta'shea') is to take delight or play with joy. It comes again in verses 47 and 70, and the noun "delight" in verses 24 and 77.
As in 119:9.

records.literal_gloss: Deal fully with your servant, [that] I may live and keep your word.

en.L: Deal bountifully with {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} servant, [that] I may live and keep {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} word.
en.B: Treat {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} servant with kindness, and I will live and hold to {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} word.
en.R: Be good to me, {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} servant, so that I can live and obey {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} word.

fr.L: Fais du bien en abondance à {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} serviteur, [pour que] je vive et que je garde {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} parole.
fr.B: Traite {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} serviteur avec bonté, et je vivrai et m’attacherai à {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} parole.
fr.R: Sois bon pour moi, {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} serviteur, pour que je puisse vivre et obéir à {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} parole.

sw.L: Umtendee mtumishi {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}} kwa ukarimu, [ili] niishi na kulishika neno {{deity_pronoun:lako|Lako}}.
sw.B: Umtendee mtumishi {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}} kwa wema, nami nitaishi na kulishika neno {{deity_pronoun:lako|Lako}}.
sw.R: Unitendee mema mimi mtumishi {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}}, ili niweze kuishi na kulitii neno {{deity_pronoun:lako|Lako}}.

es.L: Haz bien en abundancia a {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} siervo, [para que] viva y guarde {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} palabra.
es.B: Trata con bondad a {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} siervo, y viviré y me mantendré fiel a {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} palabra.
es.R: Sé bueno conmigo, que soy {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} siervo, para que pueda vivir y obedecer {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} palabra.

vi.L: Xin hậu đãi đầy tớ của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, [để] tôi được sống và giữ lời của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.
vi.B: Xin đối xử nhân từ với đầy tớ của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, thì tôi sẽ sống và giữ vững lời của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.
vi.R: Xin tốt lành với tôi, là đầy tớ của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, để tôi được sống và vâng theo lời của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.

ko.L: 주님의 종을 후하게 대하여 주십시오. [그러면] 제가 살아서 주님의 말씀을 지키겠습니다.
ko.B: 주님의 종을 너그럽게 대하여 주십시오. 그러면 제가 살아서 주님의 말씀을 굳게 지키겠습니다.
ko.R: 주님의 종인 저에게 잘해 주십시오. 그러면 제가 살아서 주님의 말씀을 따르겠습니다.

decisions.reason: Each of the eight verses of this stanza begins with the letter gimel, the third letter of the Hebrew alphabet (see 119:1).
The verb (gamal) is to deal fully with someone, often to do them good (13:6; 116:7).

decisions.choice: your servant: the psalmist speaking of himself
decisions.reason: Calling oneself someone's servant was the humble way to speak to a king or to God. The psalmist does so often in this psalm.
As in 119:9.

decisions.choice: "ton serviteur" at every level, throughout the psalm
decisions.reason: 'Eved is "esclave" at Literal elsewhere, but here the psalmist names himself before God, so every level says "serviteur", as the Psalms drafts do.

decisions.choice: "mtumishi wako" (your servant) at every level, throughout the psalm
decisions.reason: Here the psalmist names himself before God. In the Psalms Swahili says "mtumishi" for ʿeved at every level, Literal included, for God's servants and the psalmist's name for himself; "mtumwa" is kept for slavery itself (Joseph sold, 105:17; the slaves of 123:2).
Elsewhere ʿeved is "esclavo" at Literal, but when the psalmist calls himself God's servant, as in the earlier psalms, "tu siervo" is used at every level. The same holds all through this psalm.

decisions.choice: "đầy tớ của Ngài" (your servant) at every level
decisions.reason: The psalmist calls himself God's servant as the humble way to speak to him (see the meaning decision). This is a title of service, not slavery, so Literal does not say "nô lệ" here, and every level keeps the same words through the psalm.

decisions.choice: "주님의 종" (your servant) at every level, throughout the psalm
decisions.reason: The psalmist calls himself God's servant, a humble self-description before God; "종" is the word kept for a servant or slave (style guide section 6). Readable adds "저" (종인 저) where the English says "me, your servant".

records.literal_gloss: Uncover my eyes, that I may look at wonderful [things] from your instruction.

en.L: Uncover my eyes, that I may look at wonders out of {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} instruction.
en.B: Take the veil from my eyes, so that I may see the wonders in {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} instruction.
en.R: Help me see clearly, so that I can find the amazing things in {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} teaching.

fr.L: Découvre mes yeux, pour que je contemple des merveilles tirées de {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} loi.
fr.B: Ôte le voile de mes yeux, pour que je voie les merveilles de {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} instruction.
fr.R: Aide-moi à voir clair, pour que je découvre les choses étonnantes de {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} enseignement.

sw.L: Funua macho yangu, ili nitazame maajabu kutoka katika mafundisho {{deity_pronoun:yako|Yako}}.
sw.B: Liondoe pazia machoni pangu, nipate kuona maajabu yaliyomo katika mafundisho {{deity_pronoun:yako|Yako}}.
sw.R: Nisaidie nione vizuri, ili niweze kugundua mambo ya ajabu yaliyo katika mafundisho {{deity_pronoun:yako|Yako}}.

es.L: Descubre mis ojos, para que mire maravillas de {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} instrucción.
es.B: Quita el velo de mis ojos, para que vea las maravillas que hay en {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} instrucción.
es.R: Ayúdame a ver con claridad, para que encuentre las cosas asombrosas de {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} enseñanza.

vi.L: Xin mở mắt tôi ra, để tôi nhìn thấy những điều kỳ diệu từ sự dạy dỗ của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.
vi.B: Xin cất bức màn khỏi mắt tôi, để tôi thấy những điều kỳ diệu trong lời dạy dỗ của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.
vi.R: Xin giúp tôi nhìn cho rõ, để tôi tìm thấy những điều tuyệt vời trong lời dạy của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.

ko.L: 제 눈을 열어 주십시오, 제가 주님의 가르침에서 나오는 놀라운 것들을 보도록.
ko.B: 제 눈을 가린 것을 벗겨 주셔서, 주님의 가르침에 담긴 놀라운 일들을 보게 하여 주십시오.
ko.R: 제가 똑똑히 볼 수 있게 도와주십시오. 그래서 주님의 가르침 속에 있는 놀라운 것들을 찾게 해 주십시오.

decisions.choice: uncover my eyes: let me see what is hidden
decisions.reason: The verb (galah) is to uncover or reveal. The psalmist asks God to take away whatever keeps him from seeing (Numbers 24:4).

decisions.choice: wonders: things too great for people to do or grasp
decisions.reason: The word (nifla'ot) is used of God's mighty deeds (9:2; 78:4). Here it is what God's instruction holds for the one whose eyes are opened.
As in 119:1.
Balanced keeps the picture of a covering taken away.
Readable says what the request means.

source.text: גֵּ֣ר אָנֹכִ֣י בָאָ֑רֶץ אַל־תַּסְתֵּ֥ר מִ֝מֶּ֗נִּי מִצְוֺתֶֽיךָ׃

records.literal_gloss: A sojourner I [am] on the earth; do not hide from me your commands.

en.L: A sojourner I [am] on the earth; do not hide {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} commands from me.
en.B: I am only a foreigner living on the earth; do not keep {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} commands hidden from me.
en.R: I am like a visitor in this world. Do not keep me from knowing {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} commands.

fr.L: Je [suis] un étranger sur la terre ; ne me cache pas {{deity_pronoun:tes|Tes}} commandements.
fr.B: Je ne suis qu’un étranger qui vit sur la terre ; ne me cache pas {{deity_pronoun:tes|Tes}} commandements.
fr.R: Je suis comme un visiteur dans ce monde. Ne m’empêche pas de connaître {{deity_pronoun:tes|Tes}} commandements.

sw.L: Mgeni mimi [ni] duniani; usinifiche amri {{deity_pronoun:zako|Zako}}.
sw.B: Mimi ni mgeni tu ninayeishi duniani; usinifiche amri {{deity_pronoun:zako|Zako}}.
sw.R: Mimi ni kama mgeni katika ulimwengu huu. Usinizuie kuzijua amri {{deity_pronoun:zako|Zako}}.

es.L: Extranjero [soy] yo en la tierra; no escondas de mí {{deity_pronoun:tus|Tus}} mandamientos.
es.B: No soy más que un extranjero que vive en la tierra; no me ocultes {{deity_pronoun:tus|Tus}} mandamientos.
es.R: Soy como un visitante en este mundo. No dejes que me quede sin conocer {{deity_pronoun:tus|Tus}} mandamientos.

vi.L: Tôi [là] khách lạ trên đất; xin đừng giấu các điều răn của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} khỏi tôi.
vi.B: Tôi chỉ là một người ngoại kiều sống trên đất; xin đừng giấu kín các điều răn của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} khỏi tôi.
vi.R: Tôi giống như một người khách ở trong thế gian này. Xin đừng để tôi không được biết các điều răn của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.

ko.L: 저는 땅 위에서 나그네입니다. 주님의 계명들을 저에게서 숨기지 마십시오.
ko.B: 저는 이 땅에 잠시 머무는 나그네일 뿐입니다. 주님의 계명을 저에게 감추지 마십시오.
ko.R: 저는 이 세상에 손님처럼 잠시 머무는 사람입니다. 주님의 명령을 제가 알 수 있게 해 주십시오.

decisions.choice: sojourner: a foreigner living in a land not his own
decisions.reason: A sojourner (ger) lived among a people without land or family to protect him and depended on others' kindness. The psalmist feels his life on earth is like that (39:13), and so he needs God's commands to guide him.

decisions.choice: commands: what God has told his people to do
decisions.reason: As in 119:6.
Readable uses a plain word and makes clear it is a picture.

records.literal_gloss: My soul is crushed with longing for your judgments at every time.

en.L: My soul is crushed with longing for {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} judgments at all times.
en.B: I am worn thin by longing for {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} rulings, every hour.
en.R: I long for {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} decisions so much that it hurts, all the time.

fr.L: Mon âme est brisée de désir pour {{deity_pronoun:tes|Tes}} jugements en tout temps.
fr.B: Je m’épuise à désirer {{deity_pronoun:tes|Tes}} décisions, à toute heure.
fr.R: Je désire tellement {{deity_pronoun:tes|Tes}} décisions que j’en ai mal, tout le temps.

sw.L: Nafsi yangu imepondeka kwa kutamani hukumu {{deity_pronoun:zako|Zako}} nyakati zote.
sw.B: Nimedhoofika kwa kuzitamani hukumu {{deity_pronoun:zako|Zako}} kila saa.
sw.R: Ninazitamani hukumu {{deity_pronoun:zako|Zako}} sana hata inaniumiza, wakati wote.

es.L: Quebrantada está mi alma de anhelo por {{deity_pronoun:tus|Tus}} juicios en todo tiempo.
es.B: Me consumo de tanto anhelar {{deity_pronoun:tus|Tus}} dictámenes, a toda hora.
es.R: Deseo tanto {{deity_pronoun:tus|Tus}} decisiones que me duele, todo el tiempo.

vi.L: Linh hồn tôi hao mòn vì khao khát các phán quyết của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} mọi lúc.
vi.B: Tôi hao mòn vì mong mỏi các phán quyết của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} từng giờ.
vi.R: Tôi khao khát những quyết định của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đến nỗi thấy đau đớn, lúc nào cũng vậy.

ko.L: 제 영혼이 언제나 주님의 판결들을 사모하다가 부서집니다.
ko.B: 주님의 판결을 사모하는 마음에 저는 언제나 지쳐 기진합니다.
ko.R: 저는 주님의 결정을 너무나 바라서 늘 마음이 아플 지경입니다.

decisions.reason: The verb (garas) is rare; it is used of teeth broken on gravel (Lamentations 3:16). The longing is so strong that it wears the psalmist down.

decisions.choice: judgments: God's rulings, his decisions about what is right
decisions.reason: As in 119:7.
As in the earlier psalms, Literal keeps "soul" (nefesh) and Balanced and Readable say what it means here, the whole person.
As in the earlier psalms, nefesh is "alma" at Literal; Balanced and Readable say "I", as the English does, because here it is the psalmist's whole self that longs.

decisions.choice: nefesh: "영혼" (soul) at Literal; "저" (I) at Balanced and Readable, throughout the psalm
decisions.reason: As the terms note and the English: Literal keeps "영혼", Balanced and Readable say what it means here, the whole person.

records.literal_gloss: You rebuke [the] arrogant, cursed [ones], the [ones] straying from your commands.

en.L: You rebuke the arrogant, the cursed, who wander from {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} commands.
en.B: You rebuke the proud, the people under a curse who wander away from {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} commands.
en.R: You scold proud people. They are under a curse, and they wander away from {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} commands.

fr.L: Tu réprimandes les orgueilleux, les maudits, qui s’égarent loin de {{deity_pronoun:tes|Tes}} commandements.
fr.B: Tu réprimandes les orgueilleux, ces gens maudits qui s’écartent de {{deity_pronoun:tes|Tes}} commandements.
fr.R: Tu grondes les orgueilleux. Ils sont maudits, et ils s’éloignent de {{deity_pronoun:tes|Tes}} commandements.

sw.L: Unawakemea wenye kiburi, waliolaaniwa, wanaotangatanga mbali na amri {{deity_pronoun:zako|Zako}}.
sw.B: Unawakemea wenye kiburi, watu walio chini ya laana wanaopotea mbali na amri {{deity_pronoun:zako|Zako}}.
sw.R: Unawakaripia watu wenye kiburi. Wako chini ya laana, nao wanapotea wakaziacha amri {{deity_pronoun:zako|Zako}}.

es.L: Tú reprendes a los soberbios, los malditos, que se desvían de {{deity_pronoun:tus|Tus}} mandamientos.
es.B: Tú reprendes a los orgullosos, la gente bajo maldición que se aparta de {{deity_pronoun:tus|Tus}} mandamientos.
es.R: Tú regañas a los orgullosos. Están bajo maldición, y se alejan de {{deity_pronoun:tus|Tus}} mandamientos.

vi.L: Ngài quở trách những kẻ kiêu ngạo, những kẻ bị rủa sả, là những kẻ lạc khỏi các điều răn của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.
vi.B: Ngài quở trách những kẻ kiêu căng, những kẻ bị rủa sả đi lạc xa các điều răn của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.
vi.R: Ngài quở mắng những kẻ kiêu ngạo. Chúng bị rủa sả, và chúng đi lạc xa các điều răn của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.

ko.L: 주님께서 교만한 자들, 저주받은 자들, 주님의 계명들에서 벗어나는 자들을 꾸짖으십니다.
ko.B: 주님께서는 교만한 자들, 주님의 계명에서 떠나 헤매는 저주받은 자들을 꾸짖으십니다.
ko.R: 주님께서는 교만한 사람들을 꾸짖으십니다. 그들은 저주를 받았고, 주님의 명령에서 떠나 헤맵니다.

decisions.reason: The word (zedim) is for people who are proud and act against God and others without fear. They come again in verses 51, 69, 78 and 85.
God's rebuke (ga'ar) is a stern word that stops and judges (9:6).

alternatives: You rebuke the arrogant. Cursed are those who wander ...
decisions.reason: "Cursed" may describe the arrogant, as the Hebrew accents take it, or begin a new sentence, as the ancient Greek translation reads it. The meaning is much the same.

decisions.choice: commands: what God has told his people to do
decisions.reason: As in 119:6.

The Hebrew zedim are people who set themselves above God and others. Literal says "los soberbios"; Balanced and Readable say "los orgullosos", the everyday word. The same wording is kept all through the psalm.

decisions.choice: "교만한 자들" (L, B), "교만한 사람들" (R) for the arrogant, throughout the psalm
decisions.reason: The word (zedim) is people who set themselves above God and others; "교만하다" is the common word. Readable uses "사람들" for "자들", as it does for the wicked.

source.text: גַּ֣ל מֵֽ֭עָלַי חֶרְפָּ֣ה וָב֑וּז כִּ֖י עֵדֹתֶ֣יךָ נָצָֽרְתִּי׃

records.literal_gloss: Roll away from on me scorn and contempt, for your testimonies I have kept.

en.L: Roll away from me scorn and contempt, for I have kept {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} testimonies.
en.B: Lift insult and contempt off me, for I have held to {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} decrees.
en.R: Take away the insults and the scorn people heap on me. I have done what {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} have declared.

fr.L: Roule de dessus moi l’insulte et le mépris, car j’ai gardé {{deity_pronoun:tes|Tes}} témoignages.
fr.B: Enlève de moi l’insulte et le mépris, car je me suis attaché à {{deity_pronoun:tes|Tes}} décrets.
fr.R: Enlève les insultes et le mépris dont les gens me couvrent. J’ai fait ce que {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} as déclaré.

sw.L: Ondoa kutoka juu yangu lawama na dharau, kwa maana shuhuda {{deity_pronoun:zako|Zako}} nimezishika.
sw.B: Uniondolee matukano na dharau, kwa maana nimeshikamana na shuhuda {{deity_pronoun:zako|Zako}}.
sw.R: Uniondolee matusi na dharau ambazo watu wananirundikia. Nimezitii shuhuda {{deity_pronoun:zako|Zako}}.

es.L: Quita de sobre mí burla y desprecio, porque {{deity_pronoun:tus|Tus}} testimonios he guardado.
es.B: Levanta de mí el insulto y el desprecio, porque me he mantenido fiel a {{deity_pronoun:tus|Tus}} decretos.
es.R: Quita los insultos y el desprecio que la gente echa sobre mí. Yo he hecho lo que {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} has declarado.

vi.L: Xin lăn đi khỏi tôi sự sỉ nhục và sự khinh bỉ, vì tôi đã giữ các lời chứng của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.
vi.B: Xin cất sự sỉ nhục và khinh miệt khỏi tôi, vì tôi đã giữ vững các lời chứng của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.
vi.R: Xin cất đi những lời sỉ nhục và khinh miệt người ta đổ lên tôi. Tôi đã làm theo những điều {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã công bố.

ko.L: 제 위에서 모욕과 멸시를 굴려 치워 주십시오. 제가 주님의 증언들을 지켰기 때문입니다.
ko.B: 모욕과 멸시를 제게서 걷어 내 주십시오. 저는 주님의 증언을 굳게 지켰습니다.
ko.R: 사람들이 제게 퍼붓는 모욕과 비웃음을 없애 주십시오. 저는 주님께서 알려 주신 뜻대로 살았습니다.

decisions.choice: roll away from on me: take off me
decisions.reason: Scorn and contempt are pictured as a weight lying on the psalmist (Joshua 5:9).
As in 119:2.

decisions.choice: testimonies: what God has solemnly declared
decisions.reason: As in 119:2.
Readable says where the scorn comes from.

source.text: גַּ֤ם יָֽשְׁב֣וּ שָׂ֭רִים בִּ֣י נִדְבָּ֑רוּ עַ֝בְדְּךָ֗ יָשִׂ֥יחַ בְּחֻקֶּֽיךָ׃

records.literal_gloss: Even [though] officials sit, against me they speak together; your servant meditates on your statutes.

en.L: Even [though] officials sit [and] talk together against me, {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} servant meditates on {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} statutes.
en.B: Even when men in power sit and talk against me, {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} servant keeps thinking about {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} statutes.
en.R: Leaders get together and talk against me, but I, {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} servant, keep thinking about {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} laws.

fr.L: Même [si] des dignitaires siègent [et] parlent ensemble contre moi, {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} serviteur médite {{deity_pronoun:tes|Tes}} prescriptions.
fr.B: Même quand des hommes puissants siègent et parlent contre moi, {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} serviteur ne cesse de méditer {{deity_pronoun:tes|Tes}} prescriptions.
fr.R: Des chefs se réunissent et parlent contre moi, mais moi, {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} serviteur, je continue à réfléchir à {{deity_pronoun:tes|Tes}} lois.

sw.L: Hata wakuu wakiketi [na] kunena pamoja dhidi yangu, mtumishi {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}} anazitafakari kanuni {{deity_pronoun:zako|Zako}}.
sw.B: Hata watu wenye mamlaka wakiketi na kunisema vibaya, mtumishi {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}} anaendelea kuzitafakari kanuni {{deity_pronoun:zako|Zako}}.
sw.R: Viongozi hukutana na kunisema vibaya, lakini mimi mtumishi {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}} ninaendelea kuzifikiria kanuni {{deity_pronoun:zako|Zako}}.

es.L: Aunque los príncipes se sienten [y] hablen entre sí contra mí, {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} siervo medita en {{deity_pronoun:tus|Tus}} estatutos.
es.B: Aunque los poderosos se sienten a hablar contra mí, {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} siervo sigue pensando en {{deity_pronoun:tus|Tus}} estatutos.
es.R: Los líderes se reúnen y hablan contra mí, pero yo, {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} siervo, sigo pensando en {{deity_pronoun:tus|Tus}} leyes.

vi.L: Dù các quan chức ngồi [và] cùng nhau nói nghịch tôi, đầy tớ của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} [vẫn] suy ngẫm các luật lệ của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.
vi.B: Dù những người quyền thế ngồi bàn nói nghịch tôi, đầy tớ của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} vẫn mải suy nghĩ về các luật lệ của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.
vi.R: Những người lãnh đạo tụ họp lại và nói xấu tôi, nhưng tôi, đầy tớ của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, vẫn luôn suy nghĩ về luật lệ của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.

ko.L: 고관들이 앉아 저를 대적하여 함께 이야기할지라도, 주님의 종은 주님의 규례들을 묵상합니다.
ko.B: 권세 있는 자들이 앉아서 저를 헐뜯어도, 주님의 종은 주님의 규례를 깊이 생각합니다.
ko.R: 지도자들이 모여 앉아 저를 헐뜯어도, 주님의 종인 저는 주님의 법을 곰곰이 생각합니다.

decisions.reason: The word (sarim) is used of royal officials and leaders.

decisions.choice: talk together against me: plot, slander
decisions.reason: The verb (nidbar) is to speak with one another, here against the psalmist.

decisions.choice: statutes: rules that are fixed and laid down
decisions.reason: As in 119:5.

records.literal_gloss: Also your testimonies [are] my delight, the men of my counsel.

en.L: Indeed, {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} testimonies [are] my delight, the men of my counsel.
en.B: Yes, I delight in {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} decrees; they are the advisers I listen to.
en.R: What {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} have declared makes me glad. It gives me the advice I need.

fr.L: Oui, {{deity_pronoun:tes|Tes}} témoignages [sont] mes délices, les hommes de mon conseil.
fr.B: Oui, {{deity_pronoun:tes|Tes}} décrets font mes délices ; ce sont les conseillers que j’écoute.
